name: manual_2dc5be
claim: In Git Bash never export MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 for a whole session: native Python run by repo hooks then receives slash-drive-letter paths and fails with a bogus drive-root path. Set it per single command only, for example one git show ref:path call.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: two hook steps failed with a bogus drive-root path and were first misread as a repo or Windows bug; unsetting the variable made every hook pass.

rationale: 2026-10-23: two hook steps failed with a bogus drive-root path and were first misread as a repo or Windows bug; unsetting the variable made every hook pass.
